title: PickitiLauncherProtocol
description: Cross-app contract: non-secret launcher return-navigation between Syswise portal/Pickiti and direct-route apps (TaskWise). Authoritative prose: portal docs/pickiti/new-app-integration.md. Contract name pickiti-launcher-protocol version 1.0.0 — both App Brains MUST reference the same name/version.

source.notes: Chooses product label and return path. Explicit launch overwrites stored value.

launcher_origin.notes: Allow-listed origin only; reject path/query and unlisted hosts/ports.

rules: Parse source and launcher_origin before cleaning the address bar.
Return controls navigate only; they must never clear syswise_token, syswise_refresh, taskwise_token, or profile caches.
Cold/direct visit with no stored context defaults to SysWise /apps.
TaskWise has no portal /sso/taskwise page; catalog launchPath is /taskwise/ (direct). Do not invent parallel SSO without a coordinated cross_app_request.
TASKWISE_DOCUMENTATION.md claim of /sso?token=<syswiseJWT> is stale relative to current code — treat portal auth-sso.md as authority until an SSO page exists.

env_key_names_related.notes: Key NAMES only — never commit values. Taskwise .env.example has no SYSWISE_SERVICE_KEY yet (launch-code consumer not adopted).
